After the quiz

Quiz takers have nowhere to go next

Someone who finishes your quiz is curious and engaged. Right now the next step is a big one, 1:1 consulting, so most of them stop there.

No first purchase

Most of your audience can't say yes yet

Plenty of your listeners and followers want your approach but aren't ready for 1:1 support. With nothing smaller to buy, they buy nothing.

No ads

Every lead depends on today's post

All demand comes from posts and episodes. A quiet week means a quiet calendar, and there is no way to turn spend into booked calls.

Anyone not ready for 1:1 today leaves with nothing to buy, and you can't tell the serious ones from the curious.

Video script 1 · 30 to 45 seconds

The maintenance mindset

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Your car gets regular maintenance. When did you last give yourself the same?"

Body

"Most of us only think about wellness when something feels off. Then we try to overhaul everything at once, and it lasts a week. What actually works is maintenance: small body, mind and lifestyle habits you come back to every day. I'm teaching exactly how to set that up in a 60-minute live class."

CTA

"It's $17, there's a replay, and you'll leave with a one-page plan. Tap sign up to save your seat."

Shot notes: talking to camera at home in natural light, captions on, cut to a quick shot of a notebook plan at the CTA.

On-screen: "Educational content, not medical advice."

Video script 2 · 30 to 45 seconds

Three parts, one routine

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Most wellness advice only looks at one of these three things."

Body

"Body. Mind. Lifestyle. Work on one and ignore the others, and it's hard to keep going. In my live class I'll show you how they fit together into one simple routine that works with your calendar, not against it."

CTA

"Function at Your Next Level. 60 minutes, $17. Tap sign up."

Shot notes: three quick cuts, one per pillar, with the word on screen, then back to camera for the CTA.

On-screen: "Educational content, not medical advice."

From the podcast

CTA
